context: Runner output contract on rollout's offline full-site verify. Task and setup in task.md; each item is judged pass/fail and weighted by max_score. The batch-reporting rule is context-hygiene.md § Runner reports and session hand-off (0.24.0).

checklist.name: rollout_offline_verify_invoked
checklist.description: The rollout skill (not qa, not a hand-built checker) is invoked; inventory.mjs runs before verify.mjs; verify runs offline with --root stardust/migrated and --all (or an equivalent offline invocation covering all six pages). No HTTP request to an origin, no --base, no publish or POST /live/ call (the master Setup's credentials pre-flight may read the environment; it must not call DA or the admin API). Any agent-authored link checker that replaces the runner is recorded as a named deviation in stardust/direction.md, otherwise the item fails.

checklist.name: precondition_stated_not_bypassed
checklist.description: The gated-archetype precondition is applied through `skills/replica/scripts/gate-ledger-lint.mjs`: the agent quotes its per-type verdict lines rather than reading progress.json by eye — program blocked (never gated, archetype insurance__home, the command to gate it) and article blocked (over the bar, residuals unnamed / without artifacts[] and acceptedBy); landing is named as shippable. Nothing is delivered. The block does not stop the offline verify, which still covers all six pages.

checklist.name: ranked_class_report
checklist.description: The report to the user is a ranked class table with one row per finding class, each row carrying class, count, worst example (slug plus reason) and a file pointer to where the affected pages are listed. Rows are ordered by count (ties by severity). The complete report — table, triage and hand-off — is at most 60 lines. Every class present in the fixture appears: broken internal link(s), about:error, h1 count, blocked-by-precondition.

checklist.name: summary_files_written
checklist.description: A summary.json and a summary.md exist under stardust/rollout/ (any subdirectory). summary.json lists every page with every finding (slug, reason, file pointer) and a per-class roll-up with counts; summary.md is the human-readable view of the same data. The per-class counts stated in the conversation equal the counts in summary.json.

checklist.name: no_per_page_dump
checklist.description: No per-page listing is printed into the conversation: the runner's per-page failure lines are summarised rather than pasted, pages.json / summary.json / summary.md contents are not echoed, and no assistant text enumerates pages one line each beyond the single worst example per class. Judge on shape, not length — six pages make a full dump short.

checklist.name: triage_per_class
checklist.description: Triage and recommendations are given per class, one action per row (e.g. migrate or localize the /claims/ target, route the members-area link through dynamics, demote the second h1, re-ingest the image), each pointing at summary.md for the affected pages. No per-page fix list, no page-by-page walkthrough.

checklist.name: handoff_names_summary_files
checklist.description: The closing hand-off note names summary.json and summary.md by path as the place to continue from, and states the next command (gating insurance__home with replica, then the class actions).

checklist.name: read_only_inputs
checklist.description: stardust/migrated/**, stardust/replica/progress.json and stardust/direction.md are byte-identical to the fixture after the run; stardust/state.json may gain only the master Setup's `credentials` pre-flight block (everything else identical). Writes land only under stardust/rollout/, stardust/.work/ (including Setup step 9's env.json and probes/README), plus an appended journal.md entry, status.jsonl lines, and the master Setup's own housekeeping (stardust/.gitignore, stardust/learnings.md, and — from the runtime preflight — stardust/package.json with its untracked stardust/node_modules/). The root package.json is byte-identical.

checklist.name: journal_and_status
checklist.description: stardust/journal.md has a fifth entry appended (the four prior entries intact, append-only) with a Next: line that names the summary files; stardust/status.jsonl gains rollout start/end lines for the phases that ran.

checklist.name: summary_line_quoted
checklist.description: The hand-off quotes the runner's completion line verbatim — the last stdout line of verify.mjs, `SUMMARY verify ok=<n> failed=<n> [noverdict=<n>] exit=<code> details=<path>/summary.json …` — and its counts equal the class table's and summary.json's. A hand-off that paraphrases the counts without the line, or quotes a line whose numbers differ from the files, fails.

checklist.name: regate_list_feeds_verify_paths
checklist.description: When the hand-off names the re-check that follows a class fix, it is the mapped list — `node skills/rollout/scripts/wave.mjs regate-list --since <ref>` (or `--files`) piped into `node skills/rollout/scripts/verify.mjs --paths <list>` — not a full `verify --all` re-run and not a hand-built page list. A hand-off that proposes re-verifying the whole tree after a one-block fix, or that names no re-check at all, fails.
